entities.summary: Gurban Bakhshali oglu Pirimov (Primov) (Azerbaijani: Qurban Baxşəli oğlu Pirimov; October 1880, Gülablı – 29 August 1965, Baku) was an Azerbaijani folk musician and tar-player.
